PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 10th September, 2025 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993 
No.KP/40 of 2025/PRHRDD/KRT/E-FILE/14/2023/0347/KH:-In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (5) 
of section 227 read with section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj.18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat 
hereby makes the following rules further to amend the Gujarat Panchayat Services (Class III) Recruitment 
(Examination) Rules, 2021, namely:-  
1. 
(1) 
These rules may be called the Gujarat Panchayat Services (Class III) Recruitment (Examination) (Second 
Amendment) Rules, 2025.  
 
(2)  They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2.    In the Gujarat Panchayat Services (Class III) Recruitment (Examination) Rules, 2021 (hereinafter referred to as 
“the said rules”), in Annexure – A, for the entries at Serial Nos. 6 and 8, the following entries respectively shall be 
substituted, namely:-
